items.quote: Gaal son of Ebed moved with his clan into Shechem, and its citizens put their confidence in him.
items.contrast: The citizens place their confidence in Gaal, not in Abimelek.
items.reason: The pronoun “him” refers to the immediately named Gaal. The later lines reinforce the distinction by showing the citizens cursing Abimelek while Gaal challenges his rule.
